venue: 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025)

sources.locator: Call For Papers 2025 → Paper Formatting Instructions / Double-blind Reviewing

requirements.title: Double-blind anonymization
requirements.requirement: All submissions must be anonymized and may not contain any identifying information that may violate the double-blind reviewing policy; this applies to supplementary and linked material as well.

requirements.title: Nine content pages
requirements.requirement: The main text of a submitted paper is limited to nine content pages, including all figures and tables; references, checklist and optional technical appendices do not count as content pages.

requirements.title: NeurIPS 2025 style file
requirements.requirement: Submissions must be formatted using the NeurIPS 2025 LaTeX style file; submissions violating the style (e.g. decreasing margins or font sizes) may be rejected without further review.

requirements.title: 50MB submission size cap
requirements.requirement: The maximum file size for a main paper submission is 50MB.
